HomePage.title: Home
HomePage.MainDescription: Refined desserts, indulgent verrines, and artisanal ice creams, crafted to offer a unique experience at every moment. The secret is in the crème.

HeroMarquee.row2Part1: The secret is in the cream *

BannerSection.titleLine1: Those who have tasted already know.
BannerSection.description1: Our ambition goes beyond creating a frozen dessert. We aim to awaken the senses and make every bite an emotional experience.
BannerSection.description2: At MOMENTO, no shortcuts are allowedneither in flavors, nor in ingredients, nor in craftsmanship. Every creation is thoughtfully designed to deliver an authentic and memorable experience.

PartnershipSection.descriptionPart2: With MOMENTO, you offer artisan creations designed to elevate your customers’ experience and enhance your offering, simply and effectively.

section1.title: Crafted with care
section1.description: Every MOMENTO creation is made with precision and care, respecting true artisanal craftsmanship. Textures are carefully refined to achieve the perfect balance between softness, creaminess, and indulgence.

section2.title: Flavors that inspire
section2.description: Inspired by tradition and driven by creativity, our recipes offer a rich and balanced range of flavors. Every tasting is an invitation to discover new sensations while staying true to authenticity.

section3.title: Moments to share
section3.description: MOMENTO is more than a dessertit’s a moment to experience and share. For every occasion, our creations accompany the small moments that become lasting memories.

AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.description: We are a team of passionate creators.

InANutshell.description1: Born from a passion for artisanal pastry, Momento offers desserts combining expertise and creativity, with a particular focus on the quality of ingredients.
InANutshell.description2: The brand has evolved towards a diverse range of gourmet creations, from revisited classics to signature recipes, designed to offer a unique experience.
InANutshell.description3: Today, Momento continues to innovate with modern desserts, designed to create simple and memorable moments of pleasure.

history.question: How it all started
answer: The MOMENTO journey was born from a passion for exceptional desserts and ice creams.
Driven by the desire to combine tradition and creativity, we began with a simple idea: to turn every bite into a memorable moment.
Over time, we have refined our recipes and techniques to offer creations that reflect our love for detail and our pursuit of excellence.

partnership.question: Our partnership approach
answer: MOMENTO is an artisanal brand, deeply committed to quality and the coherence of its universe. For this reason, we carefully select our partners.
We prioritize establishments that share our values, our high standards of quality, and our focus on customer experience.

ingredients.question: Our ingredients
answer: We place great importance on the selection of ingredients, favoring quality, authenticity, and respect for our recipes.
Each creation is designed to offer a perfect balance of flavors, textures, and indulgence, without compromising on standards.

events.question: Orders and events
answer: MOMENTO also supports special moments through dedicated orders for professional or private events.
For any specific request, we invite you to contact us so we can explore the possibilities together based on your needs.

locations.question: Where to find MOMENTO
answer: MOMENTO creations are available through our selected partners and points of sale.
We are gradually expanding our presence to ensure consistent quality and an experience that remains true to the brand’s universe.
